# Ting 0.7.3
## New
- A small gear in the bottom-right corner of selecta and launcha opens the same menu as Ting's menu-bar icon, including Settings, updates and pause. - The launcher closes before the menu opens so its keyboard handling does not interfere with menu navigation. The gear also works when the menu-bar icon is hidden.
## Upgrade
Choose **Check for Updates…** in Ting. Settings, bindings, micro-apps and permissions are preserved. Requires macOS 14 or later; the signed, notarized and stapled universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
